recipe: Extract the verified source archive in an isolated directory. Apply typed-array.patch with patch -p1 in vendor/quickjs.

Use bun patch on the installed package. Replace dist/index.js and dist/index.js.map with the generated files, then bun patch --commit. Preserve the original license. Verify the patched main entry through the actual SubKit worker regression.
